about: Versions of the home page. Each is a frozen copy (site/versions/<version>.html) with its own images. The live one is chosen in Console → Settings → Website content. site/index.html is the working draft (previewed at /v/draft/). footerPages: the footer links to About and Contact us (the draft always has them). A version is only added here after the owner confirms a round of changes is complete.
